name: How soon can I use the shower after painting the bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How soon can I use the shower after painting the bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should wait at least 24 to 48 hours after the final coat before taking a hot, steamy shower. While modern latex paint often feels dry to the touch within a couple of hours, it takes several days to achieve full moisture resistance and complete chemical curing. Exposing fresh paint to high humidity and steam too soon can cause moisture spotting, streak marks, or blistering. When HH Remodeling completes a bathroom paint job, we advise homeowners to run the exhaust fan or open a window during the first few days of light bathroom use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wait at least 24 to 48 hours before taking a steamy shower. Early moisture exposure can cause water streaks, blistering, and finish damage.
